description: Files that may keep language or build-tool names after the Java extraction (#1495). Files listed here are not counted; retired scanner tokens still fail in them. Entries may only be removed: verify-no-host-language-specifics.mjs --base rejects new ones.

entries.reason: The only TextMate grammar the host bundles is Java's; scope names such as source.java come from that grammar (decision Q3).
entries.removeWhen: Plugins contribute TextMate grammars and the host no longer bundles one.

entries.reason: Theme token rules name the Java grammar's scopes (decision Q3).
entries.removeWhen: Plugins contribute TextMate grammars and their theme scopes.

entries.reason: Catalogs of Monaco's built-in languages and file associations, where Java and .gradle sit next to the other languages (decision Q3).
entries.removeWhen: Plugins contribute language definitions and file associations.
